senses.gloss: to describe or praise someone or something publicly as very good
senses.example: Analysts hailed the merger as a smart strategic move.

example_translations.ko_KR: 분석가들은 그 합병을 현명한 전략적 조치라고 찬사를 보냈습니다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Các nhà phân tích ca ngợi vụ sáp nhập là một bước đi chiến lược thông minh.
example_translations.th_TH: นักวิเคราะห์ยกย่องการควบรวมกิจการครั้งนี้ว่าเป็นการเคลื่อนไหวเชิงกลยุทธ์ที่ชาญฉลาด

definition_translations.ko_KR: 누군가나 무언가를 매우 훌륭하다고 공개적으로 묘사하거나 칭찬하다

senses.gloss: to call to someone or signal for a vehicle to stop
senses.example: She stepped outside to hail a taxi.
